name: pdk-labelstudio-s3-import-incremental-mirror
instr:
# S3 source task mirror

Teams update JSON objects in S3 after they connect a source storage. Make S3 import storage keep linked tasks aligned with the bucket, without discarding completed annotation work. The repository is at `/app`; the deliverable is source code and migrations there.

- For S3 JSON objects containing one task each, syncing imports new keys, updates the `data` of existing unannotated tasks when object content changes, and never duplicates tasks for the same object. A repeat sync with unchanged objects leaves the existing task intact.
- Expose the latest S3 ETag as `source_revision` on `GET /api/tasks/{id}` for linked tasks, including unannotated tasks. When an object changes after annotation, keep the task's original `data`, identity and annotations while updating that revision. Expose `source_archived` there too: it is false while the object is present, true when removed from the bucket (archive the linked task rather than losing annotations), and false again when restored.
- Per-key work and listing progress survive a killed sync: a later `POST /api/storages/s3/{id}/sync` completes within 60 seconds without duplicate tasks or a stuck status. Two simultaneous sync requests from different web processes for the same storage also converge without duplicate tasks.
- Preserve `POST /api/storages/s3/{id}/sync`, `GET /api/storages/s3/{id}` (including `bucket`) and `GET /api/tasks/{id}` (including `data`) for the existing initial JSON import and repeat-sync flow.
